check: Actual model call succeeds with the selected runtime identity, project, location and model; CLI login alone is not counted.
Initialization, a known query and source lookup pass through MCP in the actual agent runtime.
The model cannot query another table/account or remove mandatory source filters.
Broad and exact questions return supporting passages and resolving citations; unsupported questions acknowledge missing evidence.
Authorization and transport failures stop safely without repeated model retries or substitute local answers.
If applicable, revoked source access prevents metadata, passages and derived facts reaching the model.
Separate users/sessions do not share retrieved evidence; runner and transport resources are closed.
When deployed, verify IAM, anonymous denial, authenticated agent response and source links through the actual Cloud Run revision.
